source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Whenever an enemy unit, other than a **MONSTER** or **VEHICLE** unit, [Falls Back](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back) while in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of any units of yours with this ability, its models have to take [Desperate Escape tests](vsdata:core-rule/desperate-escape), each with -1 if the fleeing unit is **battle-shocked** too.

trigger.enemyWithinEngagementRangeOf: one or more friendly units with this ability

effect.desperateEscapeTests: every model in the enemy unit
